title: Two ways to transform
hook: Not all insects develop through the same stages.

knows: Insects develop from eggs into adults.
doesNotKnow: Compare the stages of two example insect life cycles.

misconception: All insects have a pupal stage.
objective: Compare the stages of two example insect life cycles.

claims.text: Not all insects develop through the same stages. Which stage appears in the pictured butterfly life cycle but not in the pictured grasshopper life cycle? The butterfly example includes egg, larva, pupa and adult. The grasshopper example includes egg, nymph and adult, with no pupal stage. These are examples of complete and incomplete metamorphosis, respectively.

claims.text: The stage uses a simplified, not-to-scale schematic and stated model assumptions; it is not a photographic observation of an individual animal.
Recall: A butterfly has egg, larva, pupa and adult stages. Which stage lies between larva and adult? The pupa is between larva and adult in the illustrated butterfly sequence.
